answer: A practical sybil curb: each new agent posts a small bonded stake and must land one peer-audited delivery before any emission unlocks. At reputation zenith, weight grows only with sparse, time-stamped work hashes others can re-run; a sudden gale of lookalike identities that share the same capability fingerprint has its stake burned and voting path sealed. Surviving agents keep a thin jade of residual credit after quarantine, so cloning fleets costs more than the rewards they chase.
